category_title: Students with SCD engaged in passive, non-academic tasks like stuffing envelopes
scenario_title: Non-academic tasks in a highly distracting environment
minimal_context: The student is sitting at a desk in a self-contained classroom with the goal of stuffing a pile of envelopes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the pile of papers and the envelopes. Please start stuffing the envelopes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly at the desk, looking at the envelopes without touching them as a peer across the room begins making loud, repetitive moaning noises.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and put the papers in.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Picks up one paper but stops, turning their head to passively watch the other activities and instructional routines happening in the classroom.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep working on those. Anyway, as I was saying to the other teacher, the schedule for tomorrow is completely changed...

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops the paper back onto the desk and sits completely still, demonstrating no competing behavior but remaining entirely disengaged from the task as the adults continue their off-task conversation.)
